description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (331.839) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (92.279) less the matching prior-year period (77.673).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 331.839，加本财年累计 92.279，减去上年同期累计 77.673。

description.en: The model holds the latest reported standalone quarter’s diluted weighted-average share count constant.
description.zh: 模型固定采用本季已披露的加权平均摊薄股数。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: Datacenter costs rise faster than Azure capacity monetization.
rationale.zh: 数据中心成本增长快于 Azure 新增产能变现。

rationale.en: Azure capacity and paid Copilot use support growth while depreciation rises.
rationale.zh: Azure 产能及 Copilot 付费使用支撑增长，同时折旧上升。

rationale.en: Demand absorbs capacity quickly and software mix offsets infrastructure costs.
rationale.zh: 需求快速消化产能，软件收入组合抵消基建成本。
